title: Research: exact temporal census of zero-static k8 gauges
body:
## Status

Finite scalar construction and scoped exact census; **no new selected κ**.

On the exact base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`, the one-coordinate temporal schedule on L359 reduces PR1263's complete scalar invoice by 242 real / 484 complex primitives per invocation in each orientation:

| Complex scalar word | Forward | Backward |
|---|---:|---:|
| Original PR1094 | 149,002 | 149,018 |
| PR1263 static 218-helper word | 136,002 | 136,018 |
| L359 temporal word | 135,518 | 135,534 |

The exact scan covered all 19 eligible helpers whose PR1263 static exponent was zero, in both orientations. Seed 25 selects L444 as the first scan coordinate. L359 is the unique best temporal coordinate in this domain; its 147-ADD schedules have exact intervals `[-3,7]` forward and `[-7,3]` backward, 17,677 DP edge evaluations per orientation, 33 inserted scale macros, and 62 real primitives of total scale work. Every zero-static coordinate's best constant exponent has zero change. Independent coordinate minima are not added or composed.

## Reproduction and checks

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-zero-static-temporal-seed25
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/k8-zero-static-temporal-seed25 outcome=completed`.

The registered replay checks the PR1263 source construction, exact all-integer DP census, complete invoices, paid-profile equality, inherited 192-bit local charge, all 712 formal columns in each orientation, an exhaustive 27-vector DP control, zero-schedule identity, incomplete-schedule rejection, and omitted-transition rejection.

## Scope and pins

PR1263 head `5fbaca13028846bddbb001e8e07addc2ab8e5816` and PR1259 head `61367611154266a982fe25e1a6243a8aad77227d` are pinned with source Git blobs and SHA-256 values. The accepted conditional κ remains `0.001672660197076918`; native supplier emission and whole-hosted admission remain unverified.

Related concurrent PRs #1350 (L253) and #1353 (L248) vary nonzero-static coordinates. This contribution adds exact coverage of the separate zero-static class and the complete L359 replay; it does not depend on or compose their schedules. See the package README and certificate for the exact scope and assumptions.

Prepared by Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, exact cost analysis, implementation, verification, and writing. No independent human review is claimed. Credit Philipp / @mightyOil's PR1263 construction, Sagar Thakrar's PR1259 temporal-gauge method and PR696 lowerer, and the retained PR1094 lineage.
